default.say: I can answer questions about your documents, or draft one for you. Tell me which you would like.

difference between.say: A development report explains how a model was built: the sample, the variables, the fitting and the cut-offs. A validation report challenges it independently, with its own evidence, and states what it could not assess. The first is written by the modelling team; the second must not read as an endorsement of it.

what does this paper cover.say: It covers staging and significant increase in credit risk, coverage by stage, and the post-model adjustments. It does not document the scenario weights, so anything about those would have to come from another source.

write the auto loan development report.say: The report is drafted and both files are ready. Two sections are supported by what you attached; the out-of-time results are not in the evidence, so that section states the gap rather than filling it.

create.instruction: A detailed Auto Loan application scorecard development report.
create.markdown:
# Auto Loan Development Report

## 1. Scope and model

This report covers the auto-loan application scorecard. The development sample runs to 1,050 accounts observed over twelve months.

## 2. Data and population

The sample was drawn from originations in the period. Exclusions and their reasons are listed in the appendix to the supplied specification.

## 3. Out-of-time results

The out-of-time testing evidence was not supplied, so this section records the gap rather than an untested result.
